entries.english: Smil von Gratzen, burgrave at Podebrad, grants the Cistercian monastery at Hohenfurt freedom from tolls in the town and district of Gratzen for wine, grain, fish, and other goods. He makes the concession out of affection for the brothers and for the salvation of his soul, and orders that the charter be confirmed by his seal.
